objective: The same minimum unit-cost reviews making every declared target width <= epsilon
held_out_policy: Do not inspect held-out outcomes until the implementation and development tests are frozen; report all cases
gates: Independent exhaustive subset oracle on tiny problems including zeros, repeated columns, reviewed items and rational boundaries
Every chosen set checked using original rational weights independently of integer solver
No more reviews than legacy greedy on larger cases; match legacy exact optimum on original cases
Every claimed minimum checked against enumeration or external solver where available
No runtime dependencies; node budget and truthful residual gap on cutoff
interpretation: Synthetic suites assess the finite-record optimization algorithm, not human adjudication or benchmark accuracy
No change to domains, targets, epsilon or unit costs between planners
Portfolio packing, surrogate bounds and grouped branch-and-bound are established optimization tools; measured software improvements do not prove method novelty
This development protocol is local and retrospective to the earlier prototype, not an externally preregistered study
